_note: Optional UPDATED-ratings override. NSDL's downloadable master freezes a bond's credit rating at the time of issue, so agency up/downgrades don't show. Drop updated ratings here (e.g. exported from CRISIL / CARE / ICRA / India Ratings) and the pipeline uses them automatically: it takes the LOWER when two agencies differ (conservative), keeps the change date, and adds a note. Empty = use NSDL ratings as-is.
_howto: Add entries under byIsin, keyed by the bond's ISIN. Give either a per-agency map or a list of rating symbols, plus the date the latest rating was assigned.
